title: Separation rules
summary: Separation rules keep the same track or the same artist from playing too often. Every value comes from this table; nothing is hidden in the code.

entities.text: The least time between two plays of the same track. The station default is 72 hours: a track plays at most once every three days.
The least time between two tracks of the same artist.
Only items that actually aired count, including tracks cut short at a boundary. Missed items and previews do not count.

usage: Edit the minimum interval of a rule to make rotation stricter or looser. A rule is checked whenever a track is chosen, including filler and rescheduled items.
steps: Open the rule you want to change.
Enter the minimum interval in hours and a note on why.
Save. Hours planned from now on use the new value.
mistakes: Setting a long interval for a small playlist. When every track is blocked, elements are skipped and segments end up short.
Setting an interval longer than the play log is kept. The history needed for the check would already be deleted.

example.title: Looser artist separation
example.text: The station has few artists, so many hours are short. Change artist separation from 4 hours to 2 hours. The next planned hours find fitting tracks more easily, and the warnings stop.

operations.edit: Only hours planned or rebuilt after the change use the new value.

min_interval_hours.label: Minimum interval
min_interval_hours.text: Hours between two plays of the same track or artist. At most the play log retention in hours.

notes.label: Notes
notes.text: Where the value comes from, for example the reference software.
